profile.headline: Indepedent Game Developer at Terryble Interactive
profile.summary:
A Graduate of Iowa State Universty with a major in Industrial Technology with an emphasis on Manufacturing.

Geographically flexible, open to international opportunities. Born in Spain with great international background gained from living in the Netherlands (4 Years) and the United States (15 Years). Quick to adapt and integrate into new environments.

positions.title: Founder, Independent Software Developer
positions.description:
✓ Led end-to-end project development, from concept to successful launch within budget
✓ Managed and collaborated with freelance contractors for efficient project execution
✓ Improved project features based on feedback from global customers
✓ Located and corrected root causes of errors & identified processes to prevent them from reoccurring
✓ Self-guided learning of programming, project design, and 2D/3D Tools
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Unity · Blender · Project Management

positions.title: Reliability Engineer / Global Equipment Effectiveness Program Owner
positions.description:
✓ Developed digital dashboard to modernize legacy tools; KPI reports per regional leaders requests
✓ Collaborated with IT & internal customers to streamline digital transformation initiatives.
✓ Led data-driven insights to support business stakeholders in decision-making.
✓ Coached & Supported users across multiple regions in Equipment Effectiveness concepts & tools
✓ Advanced user of Database Structures, Scripting SQL, and PowerBI Tools

positions.title: Plant Operations - Emerging Leaders Program
positions.description:
✓ Lead implementation of connected worker platform (Parsable) to enhance operational efficiency
✓ Improved safety through program audits & committee involvement
✓ Obtained a high-level understanding of cross functional operations within company

positions.title: Plant Operations Intern
positions.description:
✓ Performed data mining and analysis to optimize equipment reliability and maintenance schedules
✓ Optimized preventative maintenance documentation using process picture maps

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped in the restoration of an World War 2 trainer aircraft. Primarily worked on the nosecone.

projects.title: CAD 4044 Floor Plan Project
projects.description:
This is a series of render I did for a project where I had to design the interior of a house and all of the furniture, I decided to make a modern style penthouse design. Not all rooms are pictured. This was made in AutoDesk CAD 2012

http://imgur.com/a/szC2K
